facts.text: Caltech's campus life and academic work are governed by an Honor Code stating that no member of the community shall take unfair advantage of any other member.

sources.title: Honor Code - CalTech Admissions
sources.quote: No member of the Caltech community shall take unfair advantage of any other member of the Caltech community.

facts.text: All Caltech undergraduates must complete a STEM core curriculum including a yearlong physics course and mathematics covering multivariable calculus and linear algebra.

sources.title: Core Curriculum - CalTech Admissions
sources.quote: The core curriculum at Caltech consists of: First Year Mathematics: 27 units (covering Multivariable Calculus and Linear Algebra) First Year Physics: 27 units (yearlong course)
